patch_description:
Redesigned the ansatz block to be more parameter-efficient while preserving expressivity under the fixed feature-map + re-uploading schedule.

Key changes (only within EVOLVE-BLOCK):
- Reduced parameter count per block from 24 → 16 by using a single RZ layer (instead of separate pre- and post- RZ layers).
- Kept a strong entangling structure via a CZ “ring” using two staggered CZ layers (better mixing than a single 7-CZ chain for the same parameter budget).
- Structure is now: per-qubit RY → CZ ring (two layers) → per-qubit RZ.
This lowers total trainable parameters (and L2 burden) while typically improving generalization (smaller train–test gap) under the fixed 3 uploads × 2 repeats training loop.
